record.question: A burnt child __________ fire.
record.explanation: Answer A: fears. The proverb is “A burnt child fears fire.” Independent check: The fixed proverb is “A burnt child dreads the fire.” Reference: https://www.phrases.org.uk/meanings/a-burnt-child-dreads-the-fire.html.
